prompts.storm_cloud:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite atlas for small decorative effects attached to karaoke lyrics.
Output EXACTLY 16 genuinely different consecutive hand-drawn animation cels in a clean 4 columns by 4 rows square grid, read left to right then top to bottom. No drawn grid, no labels, no frame numbers. True transparent alpha background outside the subjects, clean empty gutters, each subject fully inside its own cell with at least 10% safe margins. Preserve a consistent subject scale and virtual origin in every cell. Frame 16 loops naturally into frame 1.
Style: refined modern game cel animation, clean confident silhouettes and just 3–4 flat color shapes, a little physical depth but not realistic. Restrained elegant angular accents, crisp contours, low detail, not cute, not childish. No gradients, no bloom, no glow halo, no blurry shadows, no texture, no grain, no speckles, no text, no logo, no watermark, no decorative frame or colored background. These will appear smaller than lyric lettering; prioritize a recognizable clean shape over detail. Draw real changed silhouettes/inner contours each frame, rather than repeating or translating one rigid picture.
Primary request: ONE compact dark thundercloud with a short vivid blue lightning discharge physically emerging from its underside. Cloud stays consistently centered at x=50%; cloud body occupies x=12%..88%, y=12%..42% in every cell. Build the cloud from two or three rounded slate gray shapes (#526b87, #809bb5, #b0c6d7), with a clean dark lower edge and modest flat volume. Electric blue/cyan/ivory lightning (#078eff, #32dcff, #f3feff) begins at y=42% from inside the cloud and ends by y=82%, contained in x=30%..72%. Make the lightning strongly visible in ALL sixteen active cels, alternating its jagged route between left, center and right, a short one-branch crackle, never a long tree. Keep the entire top 42% completely cloud-colored; all electric shapes begin BELOW the cloud underside so the cloud can be reused separately by clipping its lower part. Change the cloud rim subtly as the bolt crackles with substantially different paths in every cel. A single joined cloud-and-lightning effect, not a lightning icon placed next to a cloud. No rain streaks in this atlas; existing rain will be reused.
